verdictEs: EIP si quieres cobertura masiva de items y data más profunda; tarnished.dev si valoras UX moderna y fuzzy search rápida para iterar builds.
verdictEn: EIP if you want massive item coverage and deeper data; tarnished.dev if you value modern UX and fast fuzzy search to iterate builds.

useCases.reasonEn: tarnished.dev has instant fuzzy search. EIP requires browsing categories or using a more rigid filter.
